policy:
@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action == Action::"NetworkConnect", resource) ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action in [Action::"NetworkConnect", Action::"ProcessExec"], resource) when { resource in Host::"2001:db8::1" || resource in Host::"10.0.0.2" };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action == Action::"ProcessExec", resource) when { (resource in FilePrefix::"/x/" && (false || resource in FilePrefix::"/x")) };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action in Action::"FileOpen", resource == File::"/tmp/w") ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action == Action::"FileOpenReadWrite", resource is File in File::"/") when { resource == File::"/ab" } when { resource in [FilePrefix::"/a/b/", Dir::"/"] };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action == Action::"NetworkConnect", resource is Host) ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action, resource) when { resource in Host::"10.0.0.1:22" || resource in Host::"2001:db8::1" };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action in [Action::"NetworkConnect", Action::"ProcessExec"], resource) when { resource in [Host::"10.0.0.1", Host::"2001:db8::1", Host::"[2001:db8::2]:443"] };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action in [Action::"NetworkConnect", Action::"ProcessExec"], resource) when { resource in [Host::"10.0.0.2:443", Host::"[2001:db8::1]:22", Host::"2001:db8::1"] };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action == Action::"NetworkConnect", resource) ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action == Action::"NetworkConnect", resource) when { resource in Host::"10.0.0.2" || resource in Host::"2001:db8::2" };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action == Action::"NetworkConnect", resource in Host::"2001:db8::1") ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action == Action::"NetworkConnect", resource) when { resource in [Host::"*"] };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action == Action::"FileOpenReadWrite", resource in FilePrefix::"/a/b/") ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
forbid (principal, action == Action::"FileOpenReadOnly", resource in File::"/a/b/c/") unless { action != Action::"ProcessExec" };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action in [Action::"FileOpenReadOnly", Action::"ProcessExec"], resource) ;

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action, resource == File::"/tmp/") when { !(!(action == Action::"FileOpenReadOnly")) } unless { resource in FilePrefix::"/a/b/c/" };

@leash_semantics("cedar")
permit (principal, action, resource);
